lines.text: Hi, Instructor!
Hee hee. Where are we off to today?
I've got a consultation today?! I, um, I don't remember anything about it...
You'll come visit me often, right, Instructor?
If you're around, rehabilitation doesn't sound too bad.
A date in the Ark? Well, I suppose it'd be fun to try it just once.
If you're not coming, Instructor, I'll be heading out.

Where are you, Instructor? Come quickly!
I need you for something!
This Courthouse is far too stifling...
Know anywhere I can find some bottle caps? There aren't any in the Courthouse.
Catch me if you can!
Oh, come on... Do I look like a heinous criminal to you?
I'm cooking up a killer escape route today.
I've gotta keep it up if I want to get out of here.
Now nobody in the center will dare to mess with me!
What? Is this a gift... for me? Thanks, Instructor.
Hehe! I really hope it's bottle caps!
Thanks. I'll put it to good use.
Here, my bottle caps. I know they're safe in your hands, Instructor.
I think I'm starting to warm up to you, Instructor.
Lately I've been looking forward to our consultations. Why do you think that is, Instructor?
Ya sure about that? I may just run off, ya know.
Hmm? What's up?
Are ya searching for a new route?
Let's go!
Can I grab the parts after?
Are there any bottle caps here?
Let's wrap this up, shall we?
Reloading...
Can't forget 'bout these handcuffs.
Reloading!
Yehet, I came up with a new route!
At long last, I'm gonna escape!
All right, let's go!
Did you see that, Instructor?!
Got anything good?
Gotcha!
Argh!
Ah!
Ugh.
I knew it... escaping was the easy part.
I should make this one of my escape routes!
